#*******************************************************************************
# variables to change

xlims <- c(-95,-42)
ylims <- c(39,82)

path <- "model_comparisons/"

# after this, it's something like (variablePI_NU_BIO_NWA_monthly_",date,".rda")
biov2_file <- "BIO_v1_Carla/NEWsatPARscalar-cosDIF_scalRM_BIO_v1_fortran_"

# date system used for BIO files
dates_bio <- c("201210","201704","201807")
# date system used for Ocean Productivity files
# http://sites.science.oregonstate.edu/ocean.productivity/custom.php
dates_op <- c("2012275","2017091","2018182")

col_limits_pp <- c(0,3000)
col_limits_pdiff <- c(-100,100)


#*******************************************************************************
# custom functions

# function to load and format vgpm and cbpm from the ocean productivity website
get_op_pp <- function(f,new_rast) {
    rast <- raster(f)
    extent(rast) <- extent(c(xmin=-180,xmax=180,ymin=-90,ymax=90))
    rast <- crop(rast, extent(c(xlims,ylims)))
    rast[rast < 0] <- NA
    rast <- resample(rast,new_rast)
    return(rast)
}

# set extreme values of raster r to limits
set_lims <- function(r,lims) {
    r[r < lims[1]] <- lims[1]
    r[r > lims[2]] <- lims[2]
    return(r)
}

# make table of correlation coefficients with %diff values
cor_table <- function(df,var) {
    cor1 <- cor.test(df[,var],df$chl)
    cor2 <- cor.test(df[,var],df$lat)
    cor3 <- cor.test(df[,var],df$bathy)
    cor_df <- data.frame(Variable = c("chla","latitude","bathymetry"),
                         r = c(cor1$estimate,cor2$estimate,cor3$estimate),
                         p = c(cor1$p.value,cor2$p.value,cor3$p.value))
    cor_df$r <- round(cor_df$r,4)
    cor_df$p <- round(cor_df$p,4)
    p <- ggplot() +
             geom_table_npc(data=cor_df, aes(npcx=0.5, npcy=0.5), label=list(cor_df)) +
             theme_void()
    return(p)
}

# calculate percent difference between 2 matrices x and y
pdiff <- function(x,y) {
  return(100*(x-y)/y)
}

# make percent difference maps
pdiff_maps <- function(orig_rast,xlims,r1,r2,r3,r4,col_limits_pdiff,rchl,rlat,rbathy) {
    diff1 <- diff2 <- diff3 <- diff4 <- orig_rast
    values(diff1) <- pdiff(as.matrix(r1),as.matrix(orig_rast))
    values(diff2) <- pdiff(as.matrix(r2),as.matrix(orig_rast))
    values(diff3) <- pdiff(as.matrix(r3),as.matrix(orig_rast))
    values(diff4) <- pdiff(as.matrix(r4),as.matrix(orig_rast))
    full_df <- data.frame(pdiff1=getValues(diff1),
                          pdiff2=getValues(diff2),
                          pdiff3=getValues(diff3),
                          pdiff4=getValues(diff4),
                          chl=getValues(rchl),
                          lat=getValues(rlat),
                          bathy=getValues(rbathy))
    cor_plots <- list(cor_table(full_df,"pdiff1"),
                      cor_table(full_df,"pdiff2"),
                      cor_table(full_df,"pdiff3"),
                      cor_table(full_df,"pdiff4"))
    pp_rasts <- stack(set_lims(diff1,col_limits_pdiff),
                      set_lims(diff2,col_limits_pdiff),
                      set_lims(diff3,col_limits_pdiff),
                      set_lims(diff4,col_limits_pdiff))
    names(pp_rasts) <- c("DailyPP_BIOv2_VPI_NU",
                         "DailyPP_BIOv2_VPI_U",
                         "DailyPP_BIOv2_MPI_NU",
                         "DailyPP_BIOv2_MPI_U")
    mrast <- make_raster_map(pp_rasts, col_limits=col_limits_pdiff, cm = colorRampPalette(c("blue","white","red"))(100)) + theme(plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,5,0),"mm"))
    mdens <- lapply(list(diff1,diff2,diff3,diff4), FUN=dens_plot, xlims=xlims)
    final <- {wrap_plots(mdens,nrow=1) + plot_annotation(title="Percent difference")} / mrast / wrap_plots(cor_plots,nrow=1) + plot_layout(heights=c(2,14,3))
    return(final)
}

# make a percent difference density plot
dens_plot <- function(r,xlims) {
    vals <- getValues(r)
    vmean <- mean(vals,na.rm=TRUE)
    vsd <- sd(vals,na.rm=TRUE)
    xlims <- c(vmean-2*vsd,vmean+2*vsd)
    ggplot(data.frame(percent_difference=vals)) +
        geom_density(aes(percent_difference),fill="blue",alpha=0.4) +
        theme_bw() +
        scale_x_continuous(limits=xlims, position="top") +
        # ggtitle("Percent difference") +
        theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
              axis.text.y=element_blank(),
              axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=0),
              plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,1), "mm"),
              axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
}

## Results {.tabset}

This is a comparison of variations of BIOv2 with BIOv1 and VGPM, using the same input data as BIOv1. Note that with the exception of the MODIS cloud cover fraction used in BIO_v1, all of these models use data from VIIRS-SNPP.  

First, the PI parameters alphaB and PmB, along with log10(chl) are mapped to show spatial patterns that influence models BIOv1 and BIOv2. Second, BIOv1 and VGPM models are mapped, and variations of the new models:  

1. *VPI_NU* - variable PI parameters (i.e. allowed to vary pixel-to-pixel) with nonuniform biomass profile  
2. *VPI_U* - variable PI parameters with uniform profile  
3. *MPI_NU* - using the median PI parameters across the whole map, and nonuniform profile  
4. *MPI_U* - median PI parameter, uniform profile  

**WARNING: For MPI, even though the PI parameters are the same for each pixel, the biomass profile parameters are still allowed to vary by pixel, so nonuniform profiles might still look spotty. You can't use the median value of the biomass profile parameters in the same way when doing nonuniform chla profiles, otherwise chla will be the same for all depths and pixels and PP will only be driven by light levels.**  

Finally, the percent difference between the new model and BIOv1 and VGPM are mapped, with a table of Pearson's correlation coefficients between percent difference and three variables: chla, latitude, bathymetry. Note that the density plot x-axis range is the mean +- 2stdev.  

The Gregg-Carder light in BIOv2 was scaled using satellite PAR in its planar form:

    # Now we use Ed and SatPar to scale Eqdirw and Eqdifw
    #   Gregg-Carder units: Watt/m2/nm
    #   SatPAR units: mW/cm2/um
    # *1000 (W to mW), /10000 (/m2 to /cm2), *1000 (/nm to /um) = *100
    # Note that we end up with a GC matrix where row=hour, column=waveband, so we must
    # take the average light value over the whole day and spectrum to get a result
    # in the same format at SatPAR (a single average "instantaneous" value for the day)
    ScalingPARfactor = SatPAR / (mean(Ed,na.rm=TRUE)*100)

out = NULL
# Set knitr options to allow duplicate labels (needed for the subpages)
options(knitr.duplicate.label = 'allow')
# Create temporary environment which we use for knitting PP_comparison_child.Rmd
subpage_env <- new.env()

for (i in 1:length(dates_bio)) {
  
  date_bio <- dates_bio[i]
  date_op <- dates_op[i]

  # Assign filtered data and product group to subpage_env 
  assign("date_bio", date_bio, subpage_env)
  assign("date_op", date_op, subpage_env)
  assign("col_limits_pp", col_limits_pp, subpage_env)
  assign("col_limits_pdiff", col_limits_pdiff, subpage_env)
  
  # Knit PP_comparison_child.Rmd using the subpage_env and add result to out vector
  out = c(out, knitr::knit_child('PP_comparison_child.Rmd', envir = subpage_env))
  
}
